510128.name: Rapid-Fire Rifle
510128.description: Fires a barrage of rifle bullets, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

510129.name: Large Caliber Rifle
510129.description: Fires six lasers, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

510130.name: Guided Explosive Missile
510130.description: Fires eight missiles, dealing damage to a single Nikke. The missiles can be intercepted.

510131.name: Head Laser
510131.description: Fires a highly concentrated laser beam, dealing damage to all Nikkes.

510133.name: Spider Stamp
510133.description: Harvester lowers its front limbs, blocking a single Nikke's vision.

510134.name: Head Laser Ver.02
510134.description: Fires a highly concentrated laser that pierces through cover. This attack must be interrupted via Special Interruption; otherwise, it deals damage to all Nikkes.
